scoreNormalization: Equal-weight absolute differences divided by each field's 90% observed data spread (95th minus 5th percentile).
landMask: Valid WorldClim elevation cells; ocean/no-data cells omitted.
slopeMethod: Derived from elevation regridded to 15 km; local equal-area map-scale factors corrected by latitude. Regional screening only.
citations: TerraClimate (2025), monthly tmin/tmax/ppt/pet, CC0; Abatzoglou et al. (2018), doi:10.1038/sdata.2017.191; direct archive files validated 2026-11-14
WorldClim 2.1 elevation (2.5 arc-minute), SRTM-derived; Fick and Hijmans (2017), https://www.worldclim.org/data/worldclim21.html; attribution required, commercial redistribution terms to confirm
